memories.content: Mara is in a long-distance relationship with Daniel, who visited her (he flew out the previous Friday and left for the airport on 2026-05-25); his work is more tied to Vancouver, while Mara's is tied to Toronto.
During his visit, Daniel met Mara's friend Priya, and Mara's cat Jollof tolerated him.

On 2026-05-25 Daniel said out loud for the first time that he might relocate (likely from Vancouver toward Mara in Toronto), without promising; it concerns the long-standing unresolved question of who moves, which Mara had been scared to bring up.
Mara wants Daniel to only say he'll relocate if he means it; she didn't push the conversation because she needs the commitment to be genuine.

Mara feels acute loneliness and longing after Daniel leaves; the apartment feels too quiet and she missed him within an hour of his departure, a bittersweet pattern she recognizes ('classic') after good visits.
